Independent P audit
Primary is all valid terminal P-versus-P0 pairs, including identical-P calibration. Distinct-P results are an explanatory subset, never a replacement primary. No g0 subtraction. All-attempt raw outcomes are separately operational. Fresh future searches exclude meta-development promotion results.

A structural chain requires observed write, recall, same-lineage replacement and new active-record recall with continuous memory hashes. Four-task answer success is separate.
